test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: The feature of ‘Bicameralism’ in the Indian Constitution is borrowed from the Constitution of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Britain.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The feature of **'Bicameralism' **in the Indian Constitution is borrowed from the **Constitution of Britain.**
 
• Bicameralism is the **practice of having two houses **or chambers in a legislative assembly. In terms of the Indian Constitution, these two houses are the **Rajya Sabha (Council of States) and the Lok Sabha (House of the People).**
 
• Britain, with its House of Commons and House of Lords, provided the bicameral system model that India adopted to ensure an efficient system of checks and balances in governance.
 
• The British implemented this legislating system during their rule in India, which was then included into the Indian Constitution when it was framed.
 
• The adoption of bicameralism from the British constitution** reflects India's drive to bring together the best practices from constitutions around the world** while also staying rooted to its unique values and traditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Other borrowed features:**

 
• **Japan **- Concept of "procedure established by Law"
 
• **Germany **- Suspension of Fundamental Rights during the emergency
 
• **USSR **- Fundamental duties, The ideal of justice (social, economic and political) in the Preamble, Five-Year Plans
 
• **Australia **- Concurrent List, Freedom of trade, Joint sitting of the two Houses of Parliament
 
• **Canada **- Federation with a strong Centre, Advisory jurisdiction of the Supreme Court
 
• **South Africa **- Procedure for amendment of the Constitution, Election of members of Rajya Sabha
 
• **Ireland **- DPSPs.
